repo_notes.content: Preserve the existing English reference pages. The dedicated 中文接入与玩法指南 page is written entirely in Simplified Chinese and should use docs/zh-CN.md as its primary source. Sea of Fox RTS MCP is an adapter for a player’s own agent and shares the same RTS seat with the browser.

pages.title: Overview
pages.purpose: What sea-of-fox-rts-mcp is: an MCP stdio adapter letting AI agents play the Sea of Fox RTS game via a server-authorized tool API. High-level architecture (index.mjs -> src/mcp.mjs -> connection/state/orders), repo layout, and links to child pages.

pages.title: Getting Started and Configuration
pages.purpose: Install/run via npx or node index.mjs, generating in-game credentials, SEA_OF_FOX_RTS_URL / SEA_OF_FOX_RTS_TOKEN / SEA_OF_FOX_GAME_DIR, MCP host config, Node version requirements.

pages.title: CLI Entrypoint and Process Lifecycle
pages.purpose: index.mjs: --version/--help, stdout sanitation for JSON-RPC, createServer wiring, serveStdio binding, SIGINT/SIGTERM and stdin-end shutdown.

pages.title: 中文接入与玩法指南
pages.purpose: 用简体中文面向《狐狸之海》玩家编写快速入门。以 docs/zh-CN.md 为主要依据，说明在官服 RTS 海域从设置生成和撤销凭证、Node.js 要求、npm stdio 配置、玩家与 Agent 如何交接同一席位、建造和海运示例、五个工具以及常见错误。保留 API、工具名、命令和错误码的原始拼写，链接到中文原文。

page_notes.content: 请使用简体中文写整页，包括小标题与图表标签。明确玩家在游戏内开始 PVE/PVP 对局，玩家上线时始终优先，由自己的 MCP 客户端运行 Agent。不要为真实凭证提供示例值。

pages.title: MCP Tool Layer
pages.purpose: Overview of the five MCP tools exposed by src/mcp.mjs, registration helper, result/error envelopes, annotations and server instructions; links to per-tool child pages.

pages.title: Observation Tools: rts_catalog and rts_observe
pages.purpose: Catalog fetch endpoint, observe views (overview/units/buildings/islands/reserves/events), filters, pagination and cursors.

pages.title: Action Tools: rts_order and rts_build_sites
pages.purpose: Batched order execution (max 12), batchId deduplication, continueOnError, serialized order queue, receipts, and the build-site candidate lookup.

pages.title: Synchronization: rts_wait
pages.purpose: Wait condition discriminated union (tick/control/phase/unit/building/voyage/event), timeouts up to 20s, matched=false semantics, abort signals.

pages.title: Core Runtime (src/)
pages.purpose: Overview of the runtime modules: connection transport, state projection, and order schemas; how they compose behind the tool layer.

pages.title: Game Connection and Transport
pages.purpose: SeaOfFoxConnection: HTTPS/localhost URL validation, bearer auth, /api/rts/mcp/session and /catalog, Colyseus joinOrCreate, ack correlation, waiters, reconnect/disconnect and close.

pages.title: State Projection and Wait Predicates
pages.purpose: src/state.mjs observe(): header, player production plan parsing, unit/building/island serializers, scoping filters, pagination; waitPredicate construction.

pages.title: Order Schemas
pages.purpose: src/orders.mjs zod discriminated union of all order types — movement, combat, capture, production, building, naval transport, portals, Atlantis and council — plus shared entityId/coordinate primitives.

pages.title: Protocol and Gameplay Guides
pages.purpose: Overview of docs/: how the adapter shares a seat with the human player and how an agent should actually play a match.

pages.title: Control, Credentials and Batch Semantics
pages.purpose: docs/protocol.md: shared player seat, HUMAN_IN_CONTROL rejection, credential lifecycle/rotation/revocation, protocol version 1, receipts and the 128-entry history, event retention, data-vs-instruction safety.

pages.title: Agent Play Guide
pages.purpose: docs/play.md: PvE/PvP victory conditions, opening economy, builders and production queues, landing parties (embark/sail-to-island/disembark), attack/capture and hold timers.

pages.title: Project Infrastructure
pages.purpose: Overview of packaging, CI/CD, testing and repo hygiene.

pages.title: Packaging and Dependencies
pages.purpose: package.json metadata, bin/files/exports, scripts, dependency set (@modelcontextprotocol/server, @colyseus/sdk, zod) and package-lock.json; .gitignore exclusions.

pages.title: CI and Release Pipeline
pages.purpose: ci.yml matrix testing on Node 22/24, publish.yml tag-triggered version check, pack, OIDC npm publish and GitHub release, and the docs/releasing.md checklist.

pages.title: Testing
pages.purpose: test/stdio.test.mjs: spawning the adapter over stdio, protocol smoke tests, and optional real-game integration via SEA_OF_FOX_GAME_DIR.

pages.title: Glossary
pages.purpose: Definitions of MCP, Colyseus room, worldKey, player seat, controller/HUMAN_IN_CONTROL, batchId, receipt, tick, phase, fog, faction, objective island, reserves, production plan, voyage/boarding, embark/disembark, build site, rally point, Atlantis, Fountain Council, credential, trusted publishing — with file pointers.
